case.title: Card size: Compact keeps number, status, assign, customer and asset only
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide. For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Technician-A} is active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role and Time Clock on. For example: ZZAUTOTEST SV11581 Ana.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an Approved work order {Work-order-1} led by {Technician-A}, with one approved line that has {Technician-A} on it and a total above $0. For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SV11581 Card Size.
  • In Board View, "Column Selection" has "Service Advisor", "Line Count", "Estimated Hours" and "Line Technicians" on, and "Created Date" and "VIN/Serial" off (Line Technicians puts the crew avatars on the card); "Card size" is on "Detailed".
  • {User-B} is a user at {Location-A} whose role does not have "See Financial Data" (for example the "View Only" role).
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
case.custom_steps:
1. Look at the toolbar between its two dividers.
  2. Click "Card size".
  3. Click "Compact", then look at the card for {Work-order-1} and at the columns. (To check the spacing: right-click the card > Inspect, and read its padding and the gap between its blocks.)
  4. Click "Column Selection", turn "Created Date" on, and close the picker.
  5. Click "Card size", then "Detailed", and look at the card for {Work-order-1}.
  6. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher, open the density button and note which density is selected; then click "Board View".
  7. Sign in as {User-B}, open "Work Orders" > "All" > "Board View" with {Customer-A} in "Search", make sure "Card size" is on "Detailed", and look at the card for {Work-order-1}.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

The PRD rules this test checks, word for word: S3-R11 “Board View shows no Density control (SV-11580). Its spacing control is Card size (S3-R11a), which sits beside Column Selection between the toolbar’s two dividers, as in the design.” S3-R11a “Card size offers Detailed (the default) and Compact. It changes the work order cards only; columns, column order and sorting stay the same.” “Detailed shows the full card, as today: rank, work order number (with the lock icon when it can’t be assigned), status badge and assign button; the customer with the asset below it; clocked/estimated hours and the created date, then a 4px progress bar; the details row with the fields picked in Column Selection; and, below a divider, the crew avatars on the left and the work order total on the right. Card padding is 12px and the gap between blocks is 8px.” “Compact keeps only the first two blocks: rank, work order number, status badge, assign button, customer and asset. It hides the hours, created date, progress bar, details row, crew avatars and total. Card padding is 10px top and bottom and 12px left and right, and the gap between blocks is 6px.” “Column Selection offers the same fields in both sizes. A field picked while Compact is on shows on the card once the user switches to Detailed.” “Crew avatars show without the see financial data permission; only the total needs it (S5-E2).”

  • Step 1: "Card size" sits beside "Column Selection" between the toolbar's two dividers. There is no "Density" control on Board View.
  • Step 2: it offers "Detailed" and "Compact"; "Detailed" is chosen.
  • Step 3: the card keeps only the rank, work order number, status badge, assign button, customer and asset. The hours, created date, progress bar, details row (Service Advisor, Line Count), crew avatars and total are hidden. Card padding is 10px top and bottom and 12px left and right, and the gap between blocks is 6px. The columns, their order and the order of the cards are the same as before.
  • Step 4: "Column Selection" offers the same fields as in Detailed. The card stays Compact: Created Date does not show on it.
  • Step 5: the full card shows again: the top two blocks; clocked/estimated hours and the created date, then a 4px progress bar; the details row with Service Advisor, Line Count and now Created Date; and, below a divider, the crew avatars on the left and the work order total on the right. Card padding is 12px and the gap between blocks is 8px.
  • Step 6: Tech View's density is whatever it was before this test; changing Card size did not change it.
  • Step 7: {User-B} sees the crew avatars on the card, but no work order total.

Known problem (SV-11581, TESTING QA on 28 Oct 2026, fast follow; until it ships Board View has no Card size control, PRD change log v73): (1) If Board View shows no "Card size" control, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results say, the fix has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 81 (27 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, stories SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View) and SV-10049 (Story 6, Density); ticket SV-11581 (Card size). Card size added to the PRD in version 79 (27 Oct 2026) after Branko Cicovic, Slavcho Mitrov and Chris Ward agreed it on SV-11581.

  • S3-R11: “Board View shows no Density control (SV-11580). Its spacing control is Card size (S3-R11a), which sits beside Column Selection between the toolbar’s two dividers, as in the design.”
  • S3-R11a: “Card size offers Detailed (the default) and Compact. It changes the work order cards only; columns, column order and sorting stay the same.”
  • S3-R11a (Detailed): “Detailed shows the full card, as today: rank, work order number (with the lock icon when it can’t be assigned), status badge and assign button; the customer with the asset below it; clocked/estimated hours and the created date, then a 4px progress bar; the details row with the fields picked in Column Selection; and, below a divider, the crew avatars on the left and the work order total on the right. Card padding is 12px and the gap between blocks is 8px.”
  • S3-R11a (Compact): “Compact keeps only the first two blocks: rank, work order number, status badge, assign button, customer and asset. It hides the hours, created date, progress bar, details row, crew avatars and total. Card padding is 10px top and bottom and 12px left and right, and the gap between blocks is 6px.”
  • S3-R11a: “Column Selection offers the same fields in both sizes. A field picked while Compact is on shows on the card once the user switches to Detailed.”
  • S3-R11a: “Crew avatars show without the see financial data permission; only the total needs it (S5-E2).”
  • S6-R3: “Density belongs to Tech View only. Board View’s Card size (S3-R11a) is saved separately.”
  • S5-E2: “Without see financial data permission, hide all dollar-amount fields from displays, filters, and field/column pickers.”

Not yet checked against a build.

AUTOMATION: READY - EXPECT FAIL (SV-11581)
